set.body: Promote canonicalize() to an exported function with signature canonicalize(stat_vol, stat_type=c('Z','t','log10p'), df=NULL, ...). Move all stat_type/df logic out of hier_scan internals. Update vignettes/examples to lead with: zvol <- canonicalize(t_map, stat_type='t', df=24). See specs/api-consistency-plan.md §5.
set.title: [apicon] Phase 3: export canonicalize() and remove stat_type/df from hier_scan
